messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 34(3)

Article 34 Notification procedure. 3. The notification referred to in paragraph 2 shall include the following: (a) full details of the conformity assessment activities to be performed; (b) an indication of the conformity assessment module or modules and the kinds or categories of machinery or related products concerned; (c) the relevant attestation of competence.

response.text:

The notification referred to in paragraph 2 | shallInclude | an indication of the conformity assessment module or modules and the kinds or categories of machinery or related products concerned | | an indication of the conformity assessment module or modules and the kinds or categories of machinery or related products concerned
